---
title: "Module Overview"
---

The Data Skills Programme is organised into modules that develop capability step by step.

This structure is a **living framework** and will evolve as the programme grows.

## Core Modules

### Module 1 — Orientation and Data Safety

- working with confidential health data
- disclosure risk and safe outputs
- project structure and reproducible workflows

### Module 2 — Data Pipelines

- importing data
- cleaning and validation
- deriving variables
- preparing analysis-ready datasets

### Module 3 — Describing Populations

- counts and proportions
- denominators and rates
- age structure and interpretation

### Module 4 — Public Health Surveillance

- case definitions
- surveillance indicators
- data quality and bias

### Module 5 — Reporting and Communication

- clear statistical tables
- effective data visualisation
- communicating results for decision-making
